delivery.en: USPS serves American Samoa, but mainland Priority Mail often takes several days, Ground longer
delivery.zh: USPS 可送到美屬薩摩亞，但從本土寄的 Priority 常要好幾天，Ground 更久

readback.en: After 684, numbers go 3-3-4; 0 as zero or oh; US dollars; month before day; 12-hour a.m. or p.m.
readback.zh: 684 區碼後照 3-3-4 唸，0 可唸 zero 或 oh；美元；先月後日；12 時制

fraud.en: A message claiming a USPS delivery problem and asking for a link-click or personal data is a scam
fraud.zh: 自稱 USPS 投遞出問題，要你點連結或提供個資，都是詐騙

habits.en: Reply in English. People may say Talofa in person, but it is unsupported. Month first, zip codes, US dollars.
habits.zh: 用英語回。見面或說 Talofa，但不在支援清單。日期先月後日，有 zip code，用美元。

stall_local.en: A mainland Priority parcel can still be in transit for days, and the bank app will not load.
stall_local.zh: 從本土寄來的 Priority 包裹可能還在路上好幾天，而且這條連線載不動銀行 App。

reason.zh: 英式說法；美屬薩摩亞用 zip code
加勒比貨幣，這裡用美元
薩摩亞語見面問候，不在支援語言清單，AI 不應用它當接聽語

talk_style_diff.en: Mostly US English. Do not pretend to speak Samoan; Talofa may be heard but reply in English. Allow slower island USPS times; refuse fake tracking links.
talk_style_diff.zh: 大致是美式英語。不要假裝會講薩摩亞語；聽到 Talofa 也用英語回。接受島嶼郵務較慢，但拒絕假查件連結。

uncertain: 沒找到美屬薩摩亞本地政府自己發布的電話詐騙專文，fraud 依 USPS 在轄區也適用的防詐說明。
Talofa 是否用來接電話，還是多半見面用，沒有調查。
